title: Plasma ammunition back aboard: withdraw the stored dispersal plasma cell packs at The Experiment Research Station into the Plasma Cannon II ship's hold
note: 2026-11-22 12:11 UTC (Apophis): the copy of load-plasma-ammo-nova-terra for The Experiment. The Plasma Cannon II ship's hold read empty at 12:09 UTC while 2 dispersal plasma cell packs lay in its storage at The Experiment Research Station (data/stock/storage.json, read 11:13 UTC): a circuit stop `store: all` (the give-drone-stores routes) stores the packs with the rest; hunt.py keeps them aboard since commit c3a8f585, the circuit runner does not (asked of the Fleet Admiral, requests.log). Opens only for a pilot with the cannon and packs in its own storage here (requires.stored). Fitting for the ship's own weapon, shared work (rule F23): nothing is sold or bought.
